taiwan_aviation.headline: AI貨運需求強，長榮航、華航前三季獲利持穩高檔
taiwan_aviation.summary: 全球航空業面臨燃油成本攀升壓力，但受惠人工智慧帶動貨運強勁成長，長榮航空與中華航空前三季、第3季獲利持穩高檔；星宇航空則受燃油成本與貨運營收占比僅一成多影響，第3季與前三季陷入虧損。
taiwan_aviation.headline_en: AI cargo demand lifts EVA Air and China Airlines earnings as fuel costs climb
taiwan_aviation.summary_en: Taiwan's two largest carriers held up in the first nine months of 2026 as strong AI-driven cargo demand offset rising fuel costs, while STARLUX Airlines slipped into losses. EVA Air and China Airlines both kept earnings at high levels in the third quarter and the first nine months; STARLUX, with cargo making up just over 10% of its revenue, was hit harder by fuel prices.

international_aviation.headline: 漢莎航空接收首架A350-1000，同時為漢莎集團第700架空中巴士飛機
international_aviation.summary: 漢莎航空11月10日在法國圖盧茲接收首架空中巴士A350-1000，機名為「Deutschland」，註冊號D-AIFA，機身採深藍色特別塗裝，紀念航空公司成立一百週年。這架飛機同時是漢莎集團接收的第700架空中巴士飛機；漢莎首架空中巴士為1976年接收的A300B2。新機也是漢莎首架配備高速Starlink寬頻的長程飛機。
international_aviation.headline_en: Lufthansa takes delivery of its first A350-1000, its 700th Airbus aircraft
international_aviation.summary_en: Lufthansa took delivery of its first Airbus A350-1000 aircraft in Toulouse, France, on November 10, 2026. The aircraft, named "Deutschland" and registered D-AIFA, was painted in a special dark blue livery to mark the airline's centennial year. It is also the carrier's 700th Airbus aircraft overall; the German carrier took delivery of its first Airbus, an A300B2, in 1976. It is also Lufthansa's first long-haul aircraft to be fitted with high-speed Starlink broadband connectivity.

international_aviation.headline: 美政府問責局：五角大廈對310億美元F-35零件帳目進展甚微
international_aviation.summary: 美國政府問責局11月9日公布報告指出，美國國防部在清點價值約310億美元F-35零件方面進展甚微。截至2026年3月，F-35計畫持有約2600萬件零件，分散於全球700多處承包商與政府管理設施，服務美軍、7個夥伴國家與12個對外軍售客戶；國防部官員表示，總價值可能被低估。
international_aviation.headline_en: GAO finds minimal Pentagon progress accounting for $31 billion in F-35 parts
international_aviation.summary_en: The US Department of Defense has made "minimal progress" in accounting for F-35 parts worth approximately $31 billion, according to a US Government Accountability Office (GAO) report published on November 9, 2026. As of March 2026, the program held about 26 million parts at more than 700 contractor- and government-managed facilities worldwide, serving the US military, seven partner nations and 12 foreign military sales customers. DoD officials said its total value was likely understated.

international_aviation.headline: 澳航A321XLR將首度飛國際線，布里斯本—馬尼拉2027年2月上線
international_aviation.summary: 澳洲航空準備首度以空中巴士A321XLR執飛國際線，布里斯本—馬尼拉航線原定2026年10月25日導入，現延至2027年2月1日，A321XLR將取代目前執飛該航線的A330-200。布里斯本與馬尼拉相距約3596英里（5787公里），單程飛行時間約8小時；該航線2024年10月28日復航，初期每週4班，2025年10月增至每週5班。
international_aviation.headline_en: Qantas to take Airbus A321XLR international from Brisbane to Manila
international_aviation.summary_en: Australian flag carrier Qantas is preparing to take its Airbus A321XLR fleet international for the first time, with flights between Brisbane Airport (BNE) and Manila Ninoy Aquino International Airport (MNL). The airline originally planned to introduce the aircraft on October 25, 2026, but has since postponed the launch until February 1, 2027. The aircraft will replace the much larger Airbus A330-200 currently operating the route. The two cities are separated by about 3,596 miles (5,787 km), and the scheduled flight takes around eight hours each way.

international_aviation.headline: 西班牙NH90直升機在羅馬尼亞執行北約首次實戰緊急升空
international_aviation.summary: 西班牙空天軍Paznic戰術空中分遣隊兩架NH90直升機11月6日自羅馬尼亞米哈伊爾科格爾尼恰努空軍基地升空，執行首次實戰Alpha scramble，回應不明無人機。據西班牙國防參謀部表示，無人機在需要接戰前消失，兩機返回基地；這是西班牙直升機在國際北約任務中首次執行作戰緊急升空。
international_aviation.headline_en: Spanish NH90 helicopters fly first live NATO scramble in Romania
international_aviation.summary_en: Two NH90 helicopters from the Spanish Air and Space Force's Paznic tactical air detachment have carried out their first live Alpha scramble in Romania, taking off from Mihail Kogalniceanu Air Base in response to unidentified drones, Spain's Defense Staff (EMAD) said on November 6, 2026. The drones disappeared before the helicopters needed to engage them, and both aircraft returned to base. According to EMAD, it was the first operational scramble involving a Spanish helicopter deployed on an international NATO mission.
